title: •Captain Verrack

game_text: {pilot:1}, 2: any Star Cruiser. While aboard a Star Cruiser or with Admiral Ackbar, opponent’s weapon and battle destiny draws at same system are -2. Other Mon Calamari at same system are forfeit +2.
lore: Mon Calamari computer technician. Expert in power systems. His skills are desperately needed by Rebel fleet. Gunner.
